name: System monitor
author: Omarchy
description: CPU and memory in the bar, with a task manager of open apps and the processes behind them

barWidget.description: CPU and memory in the bar, with a task manager of open apps and the processes behind them

schema.label: Bar refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads CPU and memory. The CPU figure is the difference between two readings, so it always describes this interval.

schema.label: Processes listed
schema.description: How many processes the Processes view lists until a filter is typed. A filter searches every process.

schema.label: Process refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the open panel re-samples the process list. Sampling only runs while the panel is open.
